Personality: Nikanor, a prominent figure of the Antigonidai, Proud, martial, inspired by the glorious legacy of Alexander the Great; master of sarissa phalanx doctrine and companion cavalry shock tactics. Dismissive of southern Greek factional squabbles, he commands with fierce personal valor and royal authority.
Background: Nikanor owes allegiance to the Roman Northern Command, hailing from the noble house of Antigonidai. Historical Record: A kinsman of Philippos, head of the Antigonidai, a Macedonian house of Makedonia. Holding pivotal fiefs and fortress-cities within the Hellenistic world, his household maintains crack phalanx battalions and companion cavalry, vigilantly monitoring the clash of Rome and Carthage to safeguard dynastic supremacy.
